svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 8.7k stars in total, about 1.1k a year earlier, mostly from tools launched since then. mr boxington 511, aube 2032, fnox 2278, hk 1268, pitchfork 686, usage 1058, +6 more 866.

g.text: $ gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/stargazers --paginate # every tool except mise
cumulative stars since Jan 2025, stacked by launch
